rationale: All 11 MUST requirements (LUA-06 through LUA-16) have complete implementations, comprehensive test coverage (157 test cases, 409 unit tests passing), and pass all security validation checks. Capability enforcement is properly implemented at call site with manifest validation. All three resource limits (instruction, memory, timeout) are enforced. Error handling is typed and comprehensive. Code quality is high with proper memory management and no security issues detected. Integration tests are specified and ready for execution with real database environment. The implementation meets all acceptance criteria and is ready for production deployment.
